tagline.en: InternRobotics' 3B vision-language-action policy built on Qwen3-VL, for multi-camera robot control.
tagline.zh: InternRobotics 基于 Qwen3-VL 构建的 3B 视觉-语言-动作策略,面向多相机机器人控制。

en: InternVLA-A1-3B is InternRobotics' vision-language-action policy. It pairs a Qwen3-VL backbone with an action expert and a flow-matching sampler to turn camera views and an instruction into robot actions.

The runtime works with three cameras, using a past/current image pair from each, and computes the language and history features once before running the action-flow steps. Alongside the base A1-3B checkpoint there is a RoboTwin-tuned variant; it also draws on a Qwen3-VL processor and a Cosmos tokenizer, all staged locally.

In WorldFoundry you supply the multi-camera observations and instruction, and the model returns an action rollout. All checkpoints and supporting assets must be staged on the machine before inference.
zh: InternVLA-A1-3B 是 InternRobotics 的视觉-语言-动作策略。它把 Qwen3-VL 骨干与一个动作专家、一个 flow-matching 采样器结合起来,将相机视角与指令转化为机器人动作。
运行时使用三路相机,每路取过去/当前一对图像,并在动作流步骤之前一次性算好语言与历史特征。除基础 A1-3B checkpoint 外,还有一个 RoboTwin 调优变体;它还会用到 Qwen3-VL 处理器与 Cosmos tokenizer,这些都需本地备好。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供多相机观测与指令,模型便返回动作推演。所有 checkpoint 与配套素材须先在机器上备好,方可推理。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need a Qwen3-VL-based VLA policy for multi-camera robot control, especially in an ALOHA-style three-camera setup. The RoboTwin variant targets that benchmark setting.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个基于 Qwen3-VL 的 VLA 策略、用于多相机机器人控制,尤其是 ALOHA 风格的三相机配置时,选它。RoboTwin 变体面向该基准场景。

notFor.en: It expects a three-camera observation setup and outputs robot actions, not media. Several checkpoints and processor assets must be staged locally, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它预期三相机观测配置,输出机器人动作而非媒体内容。多个 checkpoint 与处理器素材须本地备好,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。
